blocks.orig: Beach days come easy at Sharazad Boutique Hotel. Set along a 230-metre stretch of Jambiani beach, the property offers 42 rooms spread across garden rooms, sea-view rooms, and beachfront suites, all with private en-suite bathrooms, coffee and tea facilities, room safes, ceiling fans, and free Wi-Fi. All rooms include private verandas or balconies, while the beachfront suites and Oasis sea-view rooms add outdoor showers for a rinse under the open sky. Four swimming pools, one restaurant, two bars, a spa and yoga shala, and beach lounge keep you busy between swims, and extras like paddle boards, clear kayaks and bicycle rentals are close at hand. The hotel also takes sustainability seriously, using solar-heated water, a desalination system and recycling initiatives throughout the property.
